title: What Grok's image generator creates
title_candidates: What Grok's image tool creates from a single description
The AI image generator inside Grok that most people have never opened
How Grok Imagine turns a few words into a full detailed image
xAI built an image generator into Grok and this is what it produces
Grok's image tool and what it makes when you get specific with the prompt
caption:
Grok Imagine turns any written description into a detailed image in seconds, no extra app needed.

It is built directly into Grok, xAI's AI assistant. You describe a scene, a face, or an object, and the model renders it from scratch. No design skills, no Photoshop. The images in this clip show the quality it can reach when you push the prompt with real detail.
